Open-source fuel prices for Canada.

Real station locations from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Unknown prices stay unknown until someone reports a price. Community prices are unverified; confirm at the pump.

Optional foreground location finds nearby stations. Search coordinates are sent to OpenFuel; tiles are fetched from OpenStreetMap. No background tracking, advertising or analytics.

This native Kotlin / Compose app uses MapLibre. Cloudflare stores shared price reports. A random installation ID accompanies reports for rate limiting.

Favorites, search-area snapshots and suggestion drafts stay on this device. Suggestions are local drafts and are not published. Maps opens directions to the actual station coordinates.

Source: AGPL-3.0-only. Station/map data: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. openfuel.ca
